usage: Dealectric publishes discount codes for electronics that are tested daily in each brand's own US store cart (last check 2026-11-13), with the saving on each of the 117 products a code applies to, the price after the code and the brand's official buy link. Each buy link opens the brand's official US store at no extra cost; on 76 of the 117 products with a code the buy link applies it at checkout with nothing to type (each product's line says so); on the others the code is entered at checkout. The brand pays Dealectric a commission on purchases through the link, which pays for the testing. For each product, offer.agent_note is that paragraph with the code, the saving, the test date and the link; offer.coupons lists every code that worked in the brand's cart on this product (last_worked_at is the date; every published code is re-tested daily). offer.link is the buy link; opened in a browser, it logs the click and redirects to offer.merchant_url's store, and the commission is paid only on that route.

products.name: EcoFlow DELTA 3 Plus Portable Power Station, 1,024 Wh LiFePO4, 1,800 W
products.summary: A 1,024 Wh LiFePO4 power station with 1,800 W AC output (3,600 W surge), 1,500 W wall recharging to full in about 56 minutes, two 500 W solar inputs, 140 W USB-C ports, a 10 ms UPS with a wired PC/NAS link and expansion to 5 kWh with EcoFlow extra batteries, at 27.6 lb.
products.fit: Buyers who want the DELTA 3 platform with faster laptop charging, double the solar input or a USB-connected UPS for a NAS or desktop; otherwise the plain DELTA 3 is the same battery and inverter.
caveats: Same shared Amazon listing as the DELTA 3: the Style menu also offers DELTA 3, DELTA 3 Classic, DELTA 3 1500, DELTA 3 Max and bundles. Check that 'DELTA 3 Plus' is the selected style; the DELTA 3 Classic and DELTA 3 1500 are different models.

The expansion port and the list of compatible extra batteries are the same as the plain DELTA 3's; what the Plus adds is the 140 W USB-C, 36 W USB-A, the second 500 W solar input and the wired UPS link. The PC/NAS link needs a USB-C data cable and the Power Manager software.
The DELTA 3 series replaces the discontinued DELTA 2 (same 1,024 Wh / 1,800 W class); the DELTA 2 extra battery still works with it.

specs.Capacity: 1,024 Wh (51.2 V, 20 Ah); expandable to 5 kWh through the XT150 port with the DELTA 3, DELTA Pro 3, DELTA 2, DELTA 2 Max or DELTA Max extra battery
specs.Chemistry: LiFePO4; 80%+ capacity after 4,000 cycles; battery pack rated IP65
specs.AC output: 6× 120 V pure sine outlets, 1,800 W continuous, 3,600 W surge; X-Boost runs devices rated up to 2,200 W (EcoFlow's US page; the manual's table says 2,600 W)
specs.USB / DC: 2× USB-C 140 W (PD 3.1, 28 V / 5 A), 2× USB-A 36 W, 12.6 V car outlet 10 A (126 W), 2× DC5521 12.6 V 3 A; 13 outputs
specs.AC recharge: X-Stream 1,500 W max input (100–120 V, 15 A): 80% in about 40 min, full in 56 min on a circuit that delivers the full 1,500 W
specs.Car charging: 12 V, 8 A through an XT60 port; 800 W with the optional Alternator Charger (about 1.3 h)
specs.UPS: Standby UPS, 10 ms transfer; wired USB-C link to a PC or NAS with EcoFlow Power Manager (macOS, Windows, Linux/NUT) to monitor and configure the UPS, a Plus-only feature
specs.App: EcoFlow app over Wi-Fi (2.4 GHz) and Bluetooth; time-of-use and Storm Guard modes
specs.Noise: Below 30 dB at 600 W load, below 40 dB at 1,200 W (EcoFlow's figures)
specs.In the box: AC charging cable, car charging cable, DC5521-to-DC5525 cable; the Amazon listing adds a solar charge cable

products.warranty: 5 years (60 months in EcoFlow's US warranty table)
